result.instructions: Tools for ExpenseIn, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which expenses are waiting for approval, and who is the approver?"; "Show me the card transactions from last month for cardholder 8."; "List the expense categories and the tax rate each one defaults to.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ExpenseIn data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run expensein_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run expensein_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run expensein_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. expensein_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: expensein_list_expenses
tools.title: List expenses
tools.description: List expenses with optional filters by user, type, status, and Unix-second date ranges (expense, submitted, approved). Returns the full filtered set. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/expenses.

user_id.description: Only expenses of this user id.

last_server_change_counter.description: Sync counter from expensein_get_server_change_counter. Returns only records changed since then; 0 for a first full sync.

tools.name: expensein_get_expense
tools.title: Get an expense
tools.description: Get one expense by id. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/expenses/{id}.

tools.name: expensein_list_expenses_for_approval
tools.title: List expenses for approval
tools.description: List expenses awaiting, approved or rejected by approval. 'from' and 'to' (Unix seconds) filter approved or rejected expenses only. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/approval/expenses/{awaiting|approved|rejected}.

approver_user_id.description: Only expenses routed to this approver user id.

tools.name: expensein_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List supplier invoices and credit notes, with filters by status, supplier, approver and date. Returns the full filtered set. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/invoices.

reference.description: Filter by the record's reference code.

supplier_id.description: Only invoices from this supplier id.

approver_id.description: Only invoices routed to this approver user id.

tools.name: expensein_get_invoice

tools.name: expensein_create_expense
tools.title: Create an expense
tools.description: Create a new expense for a user. Each call creates another expense, so do not repeat it. ExpenseIn API: POST /1.0/expenses.

expense_date.description: Date of the expense (Unix seconds, UTC).

user_id.description: The user id the expense belongs to (from expensein_list_users).

tax_amount.description: Tax amount in the account currency.

is_billable.description: Whether the expense is billable to a client.
